text: Then Job{H347} answered{H6030} and said,{H559}
No doubt{H551} but ye are the people,{H5971} And wisdom{H2451} shall die{H4191} with you.
But{H1571} I have understanding{H3824} as well as you; I am not inferior{H5307} to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things{H3644} as these?

The tents{H168} of robbers{H7703} prosper,{H7951} And they that provoke{H7264} God{H410} are secure;{H987} Into whose hand{H3027} God{H433} bringeth{H935} [abundantly].
But{H199} ask{H7592} now the beasts,{H929} and they shall teach{H3384} thee; And the birds{H5775} of the heavens,{H8064} and they shall tell{H5046} thee:
Or speak{H7878} to the earth,{H776} and it shall teach{H3384} thee; And the fishes{H1709} of the sea{H3220} shall declare{H5608} unto thee.
Who knoweth{H3045} not in all these, That the hand{H3027} of Jehovah{H3068} hath wrought{H6213} this,
In whose hand{H3027} is the soul{H5315} of every living thing,{H2416} And the breath{H7307} of all mankind?{H376}

Behold, he breaketh down,{H2040} and it cannot be built again;{H1129} He shutteth up{H5462} a man,{H376} and there can be no opening.{H6605}
Behold, he withholdeth{H6113} the waters,{H4325} and they dry up;{H3001} Again, he sendeth them out,{H7971} and they overturn{H2015} the earth.{H776}

He increaseth{H7679} the nations,{H1471} and he destroyeth{H6} them: He enlargeth{H7849} the nations,{H1471} and he leadeth{H5148} them captive.
